title: `CAST(BIGINT AS DOUBLE)` rounds to nearest, ties to even
description: A BIGINT past 2⁵³ casts to the nearest double, ties to even: 2⁵³+1 gives 2⁵³, 2⁵³+3 gives 2⁵³+4, and `MIN` and `MAX` give ∓2⁶³; NULL stays NULL.
reference: `UnFn.itof`: `FloatCode.ofInt`, the nearest double, ties to even.

provenance.notes: `sverify_dev.probe_spark`'s `_writer_probes`, run locally with ANSI on and off, on the folded and the codegen path, which agree on each. pyspark 4.3.0, Java 21.0.13, macOS arm64, session time zone UTC (BASE_CONF); probes.json's header records the earlier homelab run.
